stageReason: Needs the Ruy Lopez as White; eleven setup moves.

idea.ru: После размена на e6 пешка d5 связана, и ладья забирает коня на e4.
idea.en: After the trade on e6 the d5-pawn is pinned, so the rook takes the knight on e4.

notes: Named after Siegbert Tarrasch, who caught Zukertort (1887) and Gunsberg (1890) with it. Needs the Ruy Lopez as White.
